warm_start_policy: Native Mpc.solve: zeros(plan_size,1) on EVERY call; no reused plan.
workload: First 12 cycle-start physical states from each saved 1x response, 24 states including duplicates; identical pool for both controllers; no propagation.
order: For each block and state, alternate [1,2]/[2,1] by parity of block+state.
included: Function dispatch, physical error x-anchor, Daniel physical gain and condition_dwell_times OR MPC state normalization, native QP solve, first-action extraction and physical schedule conversion; common finite-offset/dwell, minimum-dwell and period checks.
excluded: MAT loading, offline design/build, state selection, output checksum and reference-action comparison, plant propagation, plotting, file export.
timer_policy: Individual tic/toc calls; timer overhead retained, not subtracted.
cold_policy: One first call per controller on the shared initial state, Daniel first, before validation/warmup; shared helpers may already be loaded by Daniel before MPC.
label_policy: dwell_active: min dwell within 1e-12 s of bound; conditioned: Daniel beta<1-1e-12; action_differs_from_lqr: offset infinity error >1e-10 s, not a claim about the full QP active set.
